manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
